_runner: Which machine handles a source. 'local' = your Mac (residential IP, needed for YouTube). 'cloud' = GitHub Actions (always on, no battery). 'any' = either. Omit and YouTube defaults to local, everything else to any.
_permission: ONLY creators your campaign permits you to clip. That permission is the legal basis for all of this.
